verdict.rationale: Intel documents multi-node distributed training [docs-4], large-model DeepSpeed runs [docs-3], and serving via vLLM, SGLang and Model Serving [docs-6, docs-8]. For interconnect, it markets an all-Ethernet scale-out fabric instead of NVLink [docs-14, docs-15]. Community threads independently confirm the 24 integrated 200Gb Ethernet ports and the OAM module form factor [comm-8, comm-5, comm-9]; criticism that the ports are dated [comm-10] questions competitiveness, not whether the capability exists. Missing for 10: first-party interconnect bandwidth and topology specs, documented rack-scale or multi-node system reference designs, and hands-on corroboration of large-cluster deployments.
